dct_description_sm: Contains data files (.csv format) related to compensation, salaries, diversity, and student academic performance at American colleges and universities. Data is from 2008-2023, with data primarily from 2018-2021. Each file has a related data dictionary in a .txt file.
dct_rights_sm: This dataset is licensed for use by University of Toronto faculty, students, and staff for academic research and teaching. Redistribution is prohibited.
